data.summary: The pod model-weights-svc-84f9c655-f4g8j took 31.0 seconds to become Ready, exceeding the 30.0-second SLO. This delay was primarily caused by the model.download span, which took 25.242 seconds to fetch 262144000 bytes from a remote model store. The model weights were not served from a local cache.

findings.statement: The pod startup took 31.0 seconds, exceeding the SLO of 30.0 seconds.
The 'model.download' span was the dominant factor, taking 25.242 seconds to download 262144000 bytes from http://model-hub.kubesage-infra.svc.cluster.local/weights.bin.
The 'model.download' operation did not utilise a cache, as indicated by 'cache_hit: false'.
The combined 'model.download' and 'model.load' spans accounted for 25.406 seconds of the startup time.
The 'app_init' phase, which includes model loading, lasted 27.107 seconds.

ruled_out.reason: CPU throttling was not observed during the startup window.
The image pull duration was 4.145 seconds, which is not a significant factor in the 31.0-second startup time.

recommendations.rationale: To prevent repeated downloads on every pod restart, keep model weights on a persistent volume, pre-populated by a prefetch job, and enable the application's cache reuse.
